options.label: Custom Discord Application ID
options.help: Development/team override. Leave blank to use the built-in Bedrock Panel Discord application. Register http://127.0.0.1:51120/callback for a custom app.

options.label: Custom app: Voice permissions
options.help: Request rpc.voice.read and rpc.voice.write. These scopes require Discord approval or applicable tester access.

options.label: Custom app: Message permissions
options.help: Request messages.read for message history and live message events.

options.label: Custom app: Notification permissions
options.help: Request rpc.notifications.read. Discord documents this scope as approved-partner only.

options.label: City
options.help: e.g. "Salt Lake City, US" — looked up via Open-Meteo, no account or key needed.

options.label: Default platform
options.help: Which platform the Meeting page opens to. Switching tabs on the panel still works for a one-off call on the other platform; this just sets what shows up by default.

options.label: Zoom tab: use Zoom's default key mappings
options.help: Zoom ships with these combos already bound: Alt+A mute, Alt+V video, Ctrl+Shift+A/D phone accept/decline, Alt+Q leave. If you haven't changed Zoom's own Keyboard Shortcuts there's nothing to configure; turn this off only if you've remapped them in Zoom yourself.

options.label: Zoom: Mute/unmute combo
options.help: Zoom default: Alt+A ("Mute/Unmute Audio"). Must match whatever's actually assigned in Zoom → Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts, with "Enable Global Shortcut" checked so it works even when Zoom isn't focused.

options.label: Zoom: Start/stop video combo
options.help: Zoom default: Alt+V ("Start/Stop Video").

options.label: Zoom: Accept inbound call combo
options.help: Zoom default: Ctrl+Shift+A (Zoom Phone's "Accept inbound call").

options.label: Zoom: Decline inbound call combo
options.help: Zoom default: Ctrl+Shift+D (Zoom Phone's "Decline inbound call").

options.label: Zoom: Leave meeting combo
options.help: Zoom default: Alt+Q ("Display prompt to end or leave meeting") — this opens Zoom's leave/end confirmation dialog rather than leaving instantly; you'll still need to confirm it once (in Zoom, via mouse or Enter).

options.label: Dashboard
options.help: url_path of an HA Lovelace dashboard (e.g. 'lovelace' for Overview). Use the picker above to pick one from your HA server.

options.label: Kiosk mode
options.help: Hides both the header and sidebar. Requires the kiosk-mode integration installed on your Home Assistant instance — this only sets the URL flag it reads.

options.label: Hide header
options.help: Hides just HA's top header bar. Also requires the kiosk-mode integration on your HA instance.

options.label: Hide sidebar
options.help: Hides just HA's sidebar. Also requires the kiosk-mode integration on your HA instance.

options.label: Auto-order by time zone
options.help: Sorts the chosen cities west → east by GMT offset (GMT−7 before GMT+9), ignoring the order you picked them in.

options.label: Auto-order by time zone
options.help: Sorts the chosen cities west → east by GMT offset (GMT−7 before GMT+9), ignoring the order you picked them in.

options.label: Backend
choices: Claude Code — CLI agent with tools
Open WebUI — your server (Auth tab connection)
API endpoint — your own key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, …)

options.label: Permission mode (choices depend on the backend)
Touch approval when in Manual mode (Claude Code)
Model (set from the panel Settings; blank = default)
Translation provider
choices: AI translate — your own API key (DeepSeek, OpenAI, …)

options.label: Target language code (e.g. en, es, de)
Photo style
options.help: Collage fills the screen with tilted prints (a new one every 0.5-1.5s), then holds the finished board for the interval. Videos always play full-screen.

options.label: Photos
options.help: Applies to slideshow photos only — videos are never cropped (they letterbox unless they're already 1920×480).

options.label: Change every (s)
options.help: Seconds per photo/scene. Videos always play through to the end instead; a finished collage board is displayed for this long.

options.label: Idle auto-start
options.help: Minutes of no input; 0 = never. With no panel touches or knob turns for this long, the panel switches to this page by itself; any input returns to the page you were on. Panel mode only. 0 disables auto-start — the page then only appears manually or in rotation.

options.label: Excluded pages
options.help: Exclusion list: while any picked page is on screen, idle auto-start never fires — for pages you watch without touching (dashboards, meetings). Leaving the page resumes the normal idle countdown; manual starts still work.
